ideas.pitch: A high-torque, low-center-of-gravity wireless robot optimized for rapid cornering and obstacle negotiation within the strict 350x350mm and 3kg limits.
ideas.title: AgileRover-X
ideas.why_it_could_win: Wins by prioritizing mechanical stability and agility under a continuously running clock, directly matching the core evaluation metrics of the Senior Robo Race.

ideas.pitch: A robust, low-latency manual wireless control system utilizing dual-frequency RF modules to prevent signal interference on crowded racing tracks.
ideas.title: DualFreq-WirelessLink
ideas.why_it_could_win: Eliminates common packet loss and latency issues faced by competitors on race day, ensuring precise driver control.

ideas.pitch: A custom 3D-printed independent suspension chassis designed to absorb shocks from rough obstacle courses while maintaining maximum speed.
ideas.title: TerrainMaster Suspension
ideas.why_it_could_win: Unusual physical build focused entirely on hardware durability and speed through chaotic obstacle courses, standing out in a race format.

ideas.pitch: A modular, plug-and-play 3S/6S LiPo power distribution board with integrated voltage regulation and quick-release battery housing.
ideas.title: QuickSwap LiPo Power Unit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Allows the team to instantly swap depleted batteries between heats without risking wiring failures or losing valuable track time.

ideas.pitch: A hardware-level momentum dampening circuit using manual trigger overrides for tight hairpin turns on the obstacle course.
ideas.title: PrecisionGate Braking Assist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the specific engineering challenge of high-speed overshooting on sharp turns, giving the driver superior handling precision.
